title: Global PPT Themes, Animation Engine & Step-by-Step Navigation Optimization

changes.description: Export CANONICAL_THEME_IDS with 13 authentic corporate palettes and CANONICAL_THEMES map, isolating legacy aliases (navy-blue, vscode-dark, etc.) so UI theme selectors do not render duplicate entries.

Inject space-separated HSL triplet custom properties (--pres-accent, --pres-bg, etc.) and guarantee high-contrast --pres-accent-text token adherence under the Zero Yellow-on-Light contrast rule (CR >= 8.6:1).

Add slide transition selector state (transitionType: 'slide' | 'fade' | 'zoom' | 'rise' with setTransitionType) and integrate getCustomizationSlideSteps into computeSlideMaxSteps for Archetypes 46 to 60.
Resolve effectiveThemeId honoring per-slide custom theme overrides (activeSlide?.themeId || activeThemeId) and connect store-driven transitionType to SlideTransition.
Implement motion variants for 4 transition modes ('slide', 'fade', 'zoom', 'rise') with hardware-accelerated transforms and 0.42s cubic-bezier physics.
Render all 13 canonical corporate themes without duplicates or truncated slice bounds, and add interactive transition type selector control.

Fix navigation button disabled locks on slide 0 and the final slide by deriving isRewindDisabled and isAdvanceDisabled from both slide index and intra-slide step boundaries (canRewindStep, canAdvanceStep).

Export isCustomizationSlideType and calculateCustomizationSlideStepCount, standardizing 4 intra-slide steps for Group A multi-step workflows (Archetypes 46-53) and 1 step for Group B flat overviews (Archetypes 54-60).

Add dynamic CSS transition tokens (--pres-transition-duration: 0.42s) and kinetic step utility classes (.kinetic-step-container, .kinetic-halo-active, .kinetic-step-completed, .kinetic-step-active, .kinetic-step-future).
